statements.select:
SELECT MENU_ID ,MENU_ID AS PREID , MENU_NM , MENU_LEVEL , MENU_ORDER , UP_MENU_ID , MENU_URL , MENU_URL2 , MENU_DESCRIPT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR , CLASS_NAME ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MENU WHERE UP_MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID) AS CHILD_CNT FROM T_MENU A WHERE 1=1
AND A.MENU_ID LIKE '%' + #searchMenuId# + '%'
AND A.MENU_ID LIKE '%' + #menuId# + '%'
AND A.MENU_NM LIKE '%' + #searchMenuNm# + '%'
AND A.MENU_LEVEL = #searchLevel#
AND A.MENU_ID != #searchPreMenuId#
AND ISNULL(A.UP_MENU_ID,'top') = #upmenuId#
AND A.MENU_ID = #menuId#

SELECT 'S' AS MODE ,MENU_ID , MENU_NM , MENU_LEVEL , MENU_ORDER , UP_MENU_ID , MENU_URL , CLASS_NAME , MENU_DESCRIPT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR , MENU_ID AS PRE_MENU_ID FROM T_MENU WHERE 1=1
AND UP_MENU_ID = #upMenuId#
statements.update: UPDATE T_MENU SET MENU_ID = #menuId#, MENU_NM = #menuNm#, MENU_LEVEL = #menuLevel#, MENU_ORDER = #menuOrder#, UP_MENU_ID = #upMenuId#, MENU_URL2 = #menuUrl2#, MENU_DESCRIPT = #menuDescript#, USE_YN = #useYn#, MOD_DT = GETDATE(), MOD_USR = #modUsr# WHERE MENU_ID = #menuId#
